name: The Creature

crownPassive.name: Dread
crownPassive.text: Enemy heroes have -1 Speed (never below 1) and -1 Guard (never below 0).

bond.name: Abandoned
bond.text: The first time another of your Gothic heroes dies, he gains +2 Attack. The second time, he gains +2 Attack and +1 Speed.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Rampage
actions.text: Deal 3 to the closest enemy and every enemy card next to it.

actions.name: The Pyre
actions.text: Deal 6 to every enemy card; he takes 8.

rules: 4 AP actions need Victor's Galvanism or a Mead of Poetry.
